text: 创业板指半日跌近1%，农业、消费股逆势走强。 恒生指数半日跌1%，恒生科技指数跌0.76%，MINIMAX涨超6%，阿里巴巴跌超3%。 全球债券收益率走高，日本10年期国债收益率自1996年9月以来首次升至3%，美国5年期、10年期国债收益率升至2025年初以来新高，澳洲10年期国债收益率创2011年以来新高。 中国8月RatingDog制造业PMI升至51.5，为两个月高位，出口新订单增速达六个月最快，出厂价格年内首现下滑。 日本财长称日美联手干预汇市有益，淡化美国财长贝森特敦促日本央行升息的报道。 韩国总统室政策室长金容范辞任，曾因支持单只股票杠杆E
text_en: ChiNext index fell nearly 1% at midday, with agriculture and consumer stocks bucking the trend. Hang Seng Index fell 1% at midday, Hang Seng Tech Index fell 0.76%, MINIMAX rose over 6%, Alibaba fell over 3%. Global bond yields climbed, with Japan's 10-year government bond yield rising to 3% for the first time since September 1996, US 5-year and 10-year Treasury yields hitting new highs since early 2025, and Australia's 10-year bond yield reaching a record high since 2011. China's August RatingDog manufacturing PMI rose to 51.5, a two-month high, with export new orders growing at the fastest pace in six months and factory-gate prices declining for the first time this year. Japan's finance minister said US-Japan joint forex intervention would be beneficial, downplaying reports that US Treasury Secretary Bessent urged the Bank of Japan to hike rates. South Korean presidential office policy chief Kim Yong-beom resigned; he had previously supported leveraged exposure to single stocks E
